worker_claim.report: 118 focused tests passed, along with ./dev lint and git diff --check. The packaging tests used an extracted dpkg-deb in scratch space. A disposable copy of the existing real scie reproduced the SCIE-only initial launch and passed isolated IPC discovery and restart; systemd metadata and package installation were simulated in regressions. Current version code recognized the copied genuine Arch marker and payload. No live host installation or service mutation was performed; exact-checkpoint hosted CI remains for Devlegate.
worker_claim.summary: Native-install now identifies registered systemd services from the verified unit, MainPID, IPC authority, and process owner, and recognizes the SCIE-only cached launch layout for other hosts. Runtime version output recognizes Arch and Debian native provenance only when the package marker matches the executable digest.
